steps.text: Talk to Ellamaria at the garden east of the palace.
chat: 1. Yes.

steps.text: Talk to the Wise Old Man in Draynor Village with the Ring of Charos(a).
chat: 1. Queen Ellamaria has sent me to seek your guidance.

steps.text: Quiz answers:
[C] Show them a range of colours…
[A] Take his generous gift…
[C] It's absolutely...
[B] Put on the silly helmet and jump…
[B] You of course…
[B] Ask me nicely…
[A] No, especially…
See to the survival of your crops as you see fit. It is strongly recommended to compost all patches as the gardeners will refuse to watch over them.
Always have on you: A rake, seed dibber, spade, secateurs, watering can, gardening trowel, and Ring of Charos(a).
Talk to Lyra west of Port Phasmatys.
chat: 1. Do you have any orchid seeds to spare?
2. [Charm] If you tell me your problems, I may be able to help you.
2. [Charm] Yes, I was wondering about that.
2. [Charm] Times must be very hard for you.
2. [Charm] Whatever you've done, I'm sure you had just cause.
2. [Charm] And what is the nature of this fee that you pay?
2. [Charm] If not yours, then whose blood are you offering?
2. [Charm] How can you deal with so much guilt?
1. That's a deal - I'll grow a patch of onions for you.

steps.text: The closest fairy ring to Lyra is ALQ.
Grow onions (takes 40 minutes, planting in both patches reduce chance of failure).
Once grown, talk to Lyra for the orchid seeds.
Talk to Kragen north of East Ardougne.
chat: 1. Do you have any snowdrop seeds to spare?
2. [Charm] You seem to be a little irritable, my friend.
2. [Charm] I don't like to see a fellow human being so upset.
2. [Charm] So what ails you, my friend?
2. [Charm] Well, is there anything I can do for you?
2. [Charm] So what can I do for you?
1. That's a deal - I'll let you know when your cabbages are ready.

steps.text: The closest fairy ring to Kragen is BLR.
Grow cabbages (takes 40 minutes, planting in both patches reduce chance of failure).
Once grown, talk to Kragen for the snowdrop seeds.
Talk to Elstan south of Falador.
chat: 1. Do you have any delphinium seeds to spare?
2. [Charm] That is why I have come to an expert for advice.
3. [Charm] Not just AN expert, Elstan - they say you are THE expert.
2. [Charm] Oh no, I love listening to gardening stories...
2. [Charm] Millions? Ah, just what I wanted to hear...
1. Okay, I'll grow you some marigolds.

steps.text: Grow marigolds in the patch (takes 20 minutes).
Once grown, give them to Elstan for the delphinium seeds.

sections.title: Dantaera in Catherby
notes: Item required: a filled plant pot (can be bought from Vanessa's Farming shop. nearby for 1 coin)

steps.text: Talk to Dantaera in Catherby.
chat: 1. Do you know how I could grow a White Tree?
2. [Charm] I think that there is something that you are not telling me.
2. [Charm] A secret is a dreadful burden to have to keep to yourself.
2. [Charm] Unless you allow me to do this she will die anyway.

steps.text: Travel to Ice Mountain.
Use secateurs on the White Tree located on the northern part of the Ice Mountain to get the white tree shoot.
Put the cutting in your plant pot and water it.

sections.title: Brother Althric at the Edgeville monastery

steps.text: Talk to Brother Althric at the Edgeville Monastery.
chat: 2. [Charm] These are the most beautiful rosebushes I've ever seen.

steps.text: Run over to Edgeville and throw the Ring of Charos(a) down the well.
Take 4 seeds from the red, pink, and white roses.
Retrieve your ring with the fishing rod.

sections.title: Bernald behind the Burthorpe pub
notes: Items required: a rune/pure essence, a hammer/chisel, 2 plant cures, and a pestle and mortar.

steps.text: Talk to Bernald in Burthorpe.
chat: 2. [Charm] But it is the only way that these vines will be cured.
1. I accept the deal.

steps.text: Use 1 plant cure on the vines.
Talk to Bernald again.
Talk to Alain by the Taverley tree patch.
chat: 1. I need to ask you about strong plant cures.
1. Are you sure there's nothing you can suggest?

steps.text: Use a hammer or chisel on the rune/pure essence to get rune shards.
Use a pestle and mortar on the rune shards to get rune dust.
Use the rune dust on the other plant cure to get the strong plant cure, then use it on the vines.
Talk to Bernald to get the vine seeds.
Talk to Ellamaria, ask about the statues to get a trolley.
chat: 1. How am I supposed to move statues all the way here?

steps.text: Use the trolley on the statue of a king.
Push the trolley east over the bridge.
Place the statue on the eastern plinth in the garden.
Use the trolley on the Saradomin statue.
Push the trolley north through the gate.
Watch the cutscene.
Place the statue on the southern plinth in the garden.

sections.title: Gardening
notes: Items required: 2 buckets of compost or supercompost.

steps.text: Return to Ellamaria's garden and fill the 2 plant pots with compost.
Plant everything. They take 10-15 minutes to grow and cannot die.
Talk to Ellamaria.
Talk to King Roald. (Make sure you have the Ring of Charos(a) equipped when talking to King Roald or he will not follow you into the garden.)
chat: 1. Would you like to follow me for a minute?
2. [Charm] Of course, your majesty - please forgive me.
2. [Charm] The Queen asked me to bring you.

steps.text: Watch the cutscene.
Congratulations, quest complete!
